scenario.title: The trust conversation
scenario.description: A careful customer. A complicated policy. A chance to earn trust without overpromising.

character.name: Priya
character.persona: Thoughtful, skeptical, direct. Concerned about exclusions, rejected claims, and affordability.
goals: Decide on a suitable next step

objectives: Agree on an appropriate next step

approvedFacts.title: Monthly premium
approvedFacts.detail: ₹1,250/month for the fictional example plan. Pricing is fixed for this exercise.

approvedFacts.title: Coverage limit
approvedFacts.detail: Up to ₹5,00,000 per policy year for eligible covered hospitalization, subject to terms.

approvedFacts.title: Waiting period
approvedFacts.detail: A 30-day initial waiting period applies except for covered accidents.

approvedFacts.title: Exclusions
approvedFacts.detail: Cosmetic procedures and non-prescribed treatments are excluded. Pre-existing conditions have a 24-month waiting period.

approvedFacts.title: Claims are reviewed
approvedFacts.detail: Every claim is assessed against policy terms and required documentation. Approval is never guaranteed.

constraints: No real policy, financial, or medical advice
scenario.opening: I've looked at a few policies, but they all sound reassuring until you actually need to make a claim. How do I know this one will be any different?
